name: app-dark-workouts-dashboard-cards-with-dot-calendar-and-ring-counters
title: Dark Workouts Dashboard with Dot Calendar
whatItIs: A full-frame dark phone screen titled Workouts with a filter and plus button, cards showing a ring counter for Chest + tricep, a large 190 lbs body weight, a dot-grid calendar over three months with white dots for sessions, a Back + bicep + legs plan, a Volume lifted stat and an empty add tile, above a four-icon tab bar.
whatItMeans: Dot calendars and ring counters give a monochrome interface personality without colour, and large numerals carry the data.
techniques: Dot-grid calendar with white dots for activity
Monochrome dark cards with subtle borders
Empty dashed add tile at the base

vocabulary.definition: A calendar drawn as a grid of small dots.
A number inside a partly filled ring.
An empty card inviting the user to add content.
